situation: I sit down at my desk in the morning
behavior: I write a short ordered list of what I need to finish today

situation: I notice an email needs a reply that will take ten minutes
behavior: I handle it immediately rather than letting it stack up

situation: I finish using a tool or piece of equipment
behavior: I clean it and put it back exactly where it belongs

situation: I am given a deadline two weeks out
behavior: I block out time on my calendar to work on it that same day

situation: I am partway through a task and feel like quitting
behavior: I push through to a clean stopping point before I take a break

situation: I commit verbally to do something for someone
behavior: I write it down so I will not forget

situation: I notice the kitchen counter is cluttered
behavior: I take five minutes to clear it before doing anything else

situation: I am proofreading something I wrote
behavior: I read it twice slowly to catch the small mistakes

situation: I plan a trip a few weeks ahead
behavior: I check confirmations and pack my bag the night before

situation: I see I am running slightly behind schedule
behavior: I cut the next break short to get back on track
